content.text:
Rows in the orders table now have 6px of padding above and below the text, down from 12px. I haven't looked at the page in a browser. The 16 functional tests pass, but none of them check spacing.

I added a `.page-orders .table td` rule in the Orders section of `site/css/pages.css`. The pricing page uses the same `.table` styles, so I scoped the change to the orders page and left the shared styles alone. The heading row is unchanged because the rule only targets `td`. Left and right padding is unchanged too.

STATUS: DONE
